confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Kathmandu's tourist districts, not checked against live prices. Restaurant and cafe anchors are medium confidence; hotel and hostel rates are lower confidence given wide tier variation and monsoon low-season discounting in July. Draft beer is uncommon, so beer reflects a standard bottled local lager serving. Cocktail and wine_glass are set relative to beer (about 1.75x and 1.6x) because direct knowledge is weak. The FX value was taken from search results quoting the RBA exchange-rates table; the RBA page was not opened directly, so the 15 October 2026 figure should be confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Basis is general knowledge of Kathmandu's tourist districts (Thamel, Lazimpat, Jhamsikhel) and typical Nepali tourist-town pricing such as Pokhara; no live comparison was performed.
